title: Middleware Matrix
content:
Photon supports high-performance middleware chains optimized for asynchronous iteration.

Global Interceptors

app.use(async (c, next) => {
  const start = Date.now()
  await next()
  const ms = Date.now() - start
  console.log('Request processed in ' + ms + 'ms')
})

Photon maintains sub-millisecond dispatch times even with complex nested middleware stacks.
